messages:
Alex Harper: Quick heads up — handing evening oncall to Samir. There's a small scheduled rollout at 23:30 UTC to push the batching + route-config tweak that reduces tail latency for longer sequences. Expect ~5% token-cost variance.
Samir Patel: thanks — pinged. What's the rollback plan if we see error spikes?
Alex Harper: rollback is simple: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/route-proxy --to-revision=3` in cluster inference-prod-us-west. Also we can toggle batching back with `rdwctl config set batching.enabled false` (internal tool).
Jess Rivera: noted. Are there any DB migrations or KV cache changes? I want to avoid cross-region cold starts.
Alex Harper: no DB schema work. KV cache TTL reduced from 600->300s in the canary only; it's reversible by setting TTL back to 600. No index changes.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 1767440011 at 23:30 UTC for service `route-proxy` (user: alex). Canary percentage: 10%. Observers: 10. Link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/1767440011
Morgan Li: I'll be on watch for the first 40m for traces and 5xx spikes. Will run smoke: `curl -sS https://inference.redwood.ai/healthz`
Samir Patel: I'll own pager during the 23:30–00:30 UTC window. My baseline checks: token-per-second, p50/p95 latency, 5xxs, KV cache miss rate. If p95 > 400ms or 5xx > 0.5% we revert.
Alex Harper: FYI freeze window for config changes: 23:15–00:15 UTC. No unrelated deploys please. :no_entry_sign:
Jess Rivera: added to my calendar and slack reminder. I'll run a quick eval prompt list after canary hits 10% and share results here.
Morgan Li: small checklist for observers: 1) watch traces in APM, 2) check `route-proxy` logs for `KVCache miss` spikes, 3) confirm canary QPS matches metric target. I'll post the dashboards shortly.
Samir Patel: sounds good. Alex — handing over keys; I'll post any rollbacks here. :thumbsup:
Alex Harper: thanks — leaving onboarding notes in the incident channel too. Good luck!
deploy-bot: Deploy started (1767440011) — canary rollout initiated, 10% traffic. Monitor: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/route-proxy?deploy=1767440011
Morgan Li: canary looks clean at +7m. p95 at 210ms, 5xx 0.03%.
Jess Rivera: eval set passed basic regen tests. Sharing details: https://docs.redwood.ai/evals/1767440011
Samir Patel: taking over active watch. I'll escalate if thresholds exceeded.
Alex Harper: appreciated — ping me if you need my exec creds.
